grading.title: Submission and grading
grading.usageFull: Credits up to which it scores full marks
grading.usageRankRule:
Ranked by credits spent on this challenge among those who handed in — the less you used, the higher you place.
Score = {points} × (how many used more than you) ÷ (how many handed in − 1), ties score the same, rounded to whole numbers.
The rank shifts as more people hand in and is finalised at the challenge deadline; before then the teacher and the student both see it marked provisional.
grading.usageRuleRank: By class rank: the less you used, the higher you score
grading.usageRuleThreshold: By threshold: up to {full} credits scores full marks, {zero} credits scores 0, in between pro-rated
grading.usageThresholdOrder: The 0-point threshold must be larger than the full-marks one.
